coverage: Existing zero/forward/reverse airborne raw replays and unchanged input hashes
Synthetic signed forward/reverse and decimal actual displacement; zero and nonfinite input rejection
Exact rational error calculation before display rounding
Explicit boot/ARM selection, missing/duplicate/rejected-window refusal, ARM sequence zero
CLI default output compatibility and optional comparison; invalid request preserves existing output
limits: Actual-distance inputs in new tests are synthetic, not measurements from the robot
No firmware, gain, PWM limit or distance coefficient modification
No physical straightness, 1m stopping or accuracy acceptance
User must supply independent signed displacement for the exact selected ARM endpoints
